description: Deine Aufgaben Du gestaltest E-Commerce-Erlebnisse, die Kunden begeistern und die Conversion messbar verbessern? Du denkst in durchgängigen User Journeys, hast einen scharfen Blick für UX/UI-Details und suchst eine Rolle mit voller Ownership für den Shop? Dann suchst du genau uns – und wir dich! Als unser/e E-Commerce Product Owner:in bist du die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Produkt/Dev, Operations und Marketing. Du baust Features, die Kunden weiterbringen und die Conversion messbar heben – und machst unseren Shop damit zum Maßstab in seiner Klasse. Deine Mission Full Ownership & UX/UI-Exzellenz: Du bist die treibende Kraft hinter unserem Webshop. Du ownsed die Produkt-Roadmap, steuerst die Features nach Business-Impact und sorgst für ein nahtloses, kundenfreundliches UI/UX-Erlebnis auf allen Devices. Conversion- & Journey-Optimierung: Du drehst an den richtigen Stellschrauben über den gesamten Funnel hinweg, von der Suche über die PDP (Product Detail Page) bis zum Checkout. Data-Driven Growth: GA4, BI und A/B-Tests sind deine Spielwiese. Du übernimmst die KPI-Verantwortung (CVR, AOV, Warenkorbabbrüche, RPV) und leitest daraus konkrete Hypothesen und Experimente ab. Smart Features & Ökosysteme: Du entwickelst kundenfreundliche Kompatibilitäts-Filter (Matter, Apple Home, Alexa etc.) sowie intelligente Starter-Set- und Bundle-Mechaniken, die Erklärungsbedarf reduzieren und den Warenkorbwert steigern. Next-Level AI-Shopping: Du verantwortest innovative KI-Features - von Guided Selling über semantische Suchen bis hin zum Conversational Smart-Home-Assistant. Agile Schnittstelle: Du übersetzt Kundenbedürfnisse und Business-Ziele in klare Requirements für unser Tech-, Design- und Marketing-Team und stellst die höchste Qualität bei jedem Release sicher. Dein Profil E-Commerce DNA: Mehrjährige Erfahrung im transaktionalen E-Commerce mit nachweisbaren Erfolgen bei der CVR- und Funnel-Optimierung (Du lieferst Kennzahlen, nicht nur Features!). Deep Tech- & Analytics-Verständnis: Sicheres Händchen für Web-Analytics (GA4, Tracking-Konzepte, Dashboards), Grundkenntnisse in SQL sowie fundiertes Verständnis von modernen E-Commerce-Architekturen (Shopware, Magento, commercetools oder Headless/APIs). Kommerzieller Drive: Du denkst in Deckungsbeiträgen sowie Unit Economics und priorisierst Feature-Requests knallhart nach P&L-Impact. UX/UI & Qualitätssinn: Du hast ein hervorragendes Auge für intuitive Benutzerführung und den Anspruch, nur absolut makellose, kundenfreundliche Web-Anwendungen live zu bringen. AI-First Mindset: Du nutzt KI-Tools ganz selbstverständlich in deinem täglichen Workflow, um Analysen, Specs oder Experimente extrem schnell auf das nächste Level zu heben. Sprachkenntnisse: Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und hervorragende Englischkenntnisse. Office-First & Team-Vibes: Du liebst den persönlichen Austausch, schätzt schnelle Kommunikationswege und hast richtig Lust, jeden Tag gemeinsam mit deinem Team in unserem wunderschönen Office im Herzen von Berlin-Mitte zu arbeiten. Nice-to-haves: Erfahrung im Umfeld erklärungsbedürftiger Produkte (Consumer Electronics, Technik oder Smart Home). Verständnis für Smart-Home-Standards und Plattform-Ökosysteme. Gespür für Merchandising, Pricing-Schnittstellen und Margenlogik bei Sets/Bundles. Warum wir? tink Kultur tink Mission: Wir verbinden ein erfolgreiches Geschäftsmodell mit der Mission, allen Haushalten einen Zugang zu einem nachhaltigeren und smarten Zuhause zu ermöglichen. Expertise: Ein erfahrenes Management-Team mit langjährigem Hintergrund im Startup-, Industrie- und Beratungsgeschäft International: Unser Team kommt aus über 30 verschiedenen Nationen Diversität: Wir freuen uns über Bewerber:innen jeglicher Nationalität, ethnischer Herkunft, religiöser Zugehörigkeit, sexueller Orientierung und jeglichen Geschlechts. Bei uns zählen Persönlichkeit und Performance. Persönliche Weiterentwicklung: Regelmäßige Feedback Runden und Reviews - Deine professionelle und persönliche Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen! Faire Kommunikation: Wir haben eine offene und transparente Feedback-Kultur. Office Policy: Wir sind ein Presence-first Team und arbeiten gemeinsam im Büro Tink Benefits Remote Option: Du hast die Option auf bis zu 4 Wochen Remote Work pro Jahr Freizeit: Bis zu 30 Urlaubstage (nach Betriebszugehörigkeit) Gehalt: Wir zahlen leistungsgerecht und fair Start your day right: Wir haben eine top Kaffeemaschine, Müsli und frisches Obst Fitness: Bleibe fit mit dem bezuschussten Urban Sports Club Membership Shopping: Erfülle Dir einen Wunsch mit monatlichem SpendIt Card Budget Fun: Regelmäßige Teamevents & eine stets gut bestückte Bar Office: Ein wunderschönes helles Office direkt im Herzen von Berlin-Mitte am Hackeschen Markt mit vielen Meeting Räumen, Küche, Snacks, Getränken, Lounge-Area und umgeben von vielen Restaurants und Cafés Visa-Support: Wir unterstützen Kandidat:innen im kompletten Visa-Prozess Über uns tink baut die führende Plattform für smartes und nachhaltiges Wohnen. Wir haben es uns zum Ziel gesetzt, jedes Zuhause komfortabler, sicherer und klimafreundlicher zu gestalten. Wie wir das schaffen? Mit unserer Plattform bieten wir für jeden Smart Home Use Case die Kombination der besten Hardware, Software und Services. Dafür arbeiten wir mit renommierten Partnern, wie Google, Apple, Tado und Bosch zusammen und bieten Endkunden alles aus einer Hand für ihr Smart Home. In den vergangenen Jahren haben wir über 50 Millionen Euro an Funding von Top-Investoren erhalten, eine Kundenbasis von über 1,5 Millionen Kunden aufbauen können und die Internationalisierung von tink in vier weitere Länder vorangetrieben. Bei der Etablierung von tink als führende IoT Commerce Plattform in Europa befinden wir uns auf Wachstumskurs – werde Teil dieser Erfolgsgeschichte und gestalte mit uns die Zukunft!

description: Join Kainos and Shape the Future At Kainos, we’re problem solvers, innovators, and collaborators - driven by a shared mission to create real impact. Whether we’re transforming digital services for millions, delivering cutting-edge Workday solutions, or pushing the boundaries of technology, we do it together. We believe in a people-first culture , where your ideas are valued, your growth is supported, and your contributions truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be part of a diverse, ambitious team that celebrates creativity and collaboration. Ready to make your mark? Join us and be part of something bigger. Job Profile Description Main purpose of the role & responsibilities in the business: Our vision is to create a world-class business development and marketing capability for Kainos, fuelled by a diverse range of highly talented and motivated professionals working collaboratively and innovatively to ensure we continue our growth trajectory. We do this via an open and supportive environment where colleagues can share information, learn from one another, and excel in their own career. With consistent ways of working aligned to industry best practice, we build sustainable and predictable sales pipelines for our market-leading offerings. What You’ll Do As a GTM Activation Marketing Manager, working within the Campaign Activation team and reporting to the VP of Campaign Activation, you will develop and own the GTM activation strategy, campaign plans and integrated activation approach that fully align with commercial priorities and sales plans to support growth and ambitions for the Workday Product Business Unit. You will act as the bridge between campaign strategy and execution, translating commercial priorities into high-impact, multi-channel campaigns and ensuring they are effectively activated, orchestrated, and optimised across the full buyer journey. You will also be responsible for translating strategic product and campaign messaging into effective activation across campaign touchpoints, ensuring consistent and compelling messaging throughout the buyer journey. Working in close partnership with Sales & SDRs, Product Marketing, Alliances, Sales Enablement, and wider marketing teams (Marketing Operations, Content, Brand, Events), you will ensure strong alignment from campaign launch through to follow-up, delivering against agreed goals including pipeline generation, progression, and conversion. You will use your extensive experience and commercial knowledge to maximise the impact of marketing on the business. You will foster strong relationships with key internal stakeholders and external partners, acting as a trusted advisor. Key Responsibilities Owning and implementing campaign activation strategy, plans and budgets – you will develop, own and implement integrated campaign plans aligned to commercial priorities for the Workday Product BU. You will define target audiences, messaging, and channel approach, ensuring campaigns are strategically aligned, prioritised and set up for successful execution, balancing commercial priorities, audience strategy, and resource considerations across concurrent campaigns. You will own campaign budgets and ensure activity is delivered on time and within budget. Owning, creating and activating campaigns and content – you will manage the end-to-end delivery of integrated, multi-channel campaigns to drive defined objectives including brand awareness, demand generation, and pipeline acceleration. You will lead cross-functional campaign orchestration across specialist functions to ensure campaigns are executed effectively across channels and aligned to objectives. Working from core messaging frameworks provided by Product Marketing, your team will apply and adapt campaign messaging across channels and touchpoints including emails, landing pages, webinar communications, nurture flows, and campaign CTAs to support campaign objectives and audience engagement. Sales alignment, enablement and pipeline conversion – you will work closely with Sales and SDR teams to ensure the successful launch, activation, and follow-up of campaigns, driving strong lead management and conversion. You will partner with Sales Enablement on key campaigns to ensure sales teams are equipped with the right messaging, content, and tools to engage prospects and progress opportunities. Reporting, accountability and ROI – you will own overall campaign effectiveness and ROI, reporting on performance across campaigns and activities for the Workday Product BU. You will partner with Marketing Operations and use insights and data to optimise performance and continuously improve campaign effectiveness. Strategic alliances with Partners – you will work closely with Alliances and Partner Marketing to identify co-marketing opportunities to enhance campaign reach and impact. You will use market insight to identify new opportunities to drive commercial benefit. Working as a team with a focus on collaboration and stakeholder management – you will proactively collaborate as part of the Campaign Activation team and the wider marketing function to deliver against overall OKRs. You will act as a central point of coordination, building strong relationships with stakeholders and acting as a trusted advisor. You will also provide leadership and guidance across campaign activity, helping drive consistency and best practice across GTM activation. Minimum (essential) Requirements Substantial experience in marketing, including at a strategic/management level, with clear evidence of success in prior roles Experience in B2B campaign activation and delivery, with a strong track record of executing integrated, multi-channel campaigns Experience of developing marketing strategies focused on maximising success in target markets Experience in developing and implementing marketing campaigns that drive business results and meet objectives Strong experience working with Sales and SDR teams to generate and convert pipeline Strong understanding and experience of CRM and marketing automation platforms Demonstrated ability to communicate, present, influence credibly and build strong trusted relationships - at all levels of the organisation and with external partners Experience of working in a matrixed environment, collaborating across multiple teams Capable of managing multiple campaigns and priorities in a highly competitive and fast-paced environment while meeting deadlines Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills Ability to cultivate ideas while aligning to brand and messaging strategy Ability to think ‘outside the box’ Desirable Degree or Higher in Marketing, Communications, or a similar, relevant discipline Experience within the Workday ecosystem or enterprise SaaS environment Experience delivering co-marketing campaigns with strategic partners Event and project management experience as part of integrated campaigns Understanding of generating leads and managing them through to qualification Broad technology experience and awareness of technology trends and their impact on marketing plans Embracing our differences At Kainos, we believe in the power of diversity, equity and inclusion. We are committed to building a team that is as diverse as the world we live in, where everyone is valued, respected, and given an equal chance to thrive.   We actively seek out talented people from all backgrounds, regardless of age, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes them who they are.   We also believe every candidate deserves a level playing field. Our friendly talent acquisition team is here to support you every step of the way, so if you require any accommodations or adjustments, we encourage you to reach out. We understand that everyone's journey is different, and by having a private conversation we can ensure that our recruitment process is tailored to your needs.
title: GTM Activation Marketing Manager - Workday Product

description: Role: Product Management Location: Gurugram & Bangalore About The Function The Domestic Hotels Product Team strives to delivering unparalleled experiences for customers seeking hotel accommodations. Our efforts are led by a profound understanding of customer challenges, extensive data analysis, and identification of root causes. From architecting powerful backend systems to creating intuitive, delightful user journeys, the function is shaping the future of Hotels making every booking effortless, personalized, and unforgettable. About The Role As a Product Manager, the responsibility will be to lead high-impact initiatives in a fast-paced, innovation-driven environment. The role entails full ownership of the product lifecycle from concept and strategy to launch and ongoing enhancement while working closely with cross-functional teams to drive measurable improvements. This position offers the opportunity to collaborate with leading industry professionals and influence the creation of exceptional, customer-first experiences in the Hotels space. What Will You Be Doing Define and drive the product vision and strategy for Domestic Hotels, aligning initiatives with growth, revenue, and customer experience goals. Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle — from strategy and roadmap to feature launches and post-launch optimization. Own and optimize scalable product systems to improve funnel efficiency, conversion, retention, and the post-sales consumer experience. Design seamless, high-impact experiences for consumers and accommodation partners across frontend and backend platforms. Collaborate with cross-functional teams — Revenue, Category, Supply, Design, and Technology — to deliver cohesive, high-impact product solutions. Lead product releases in collaboration with Engineering, Design, and QA to ensure quality and timely delivery. Product Management experience in B2C ecommerce product environment; good communication and stakeholder management skills is a must-have for this role. Key Success Factors for the Role Passion for data Passion for data and an exceptional ability to solve complex problems. High ownership High ownership and end-to-end problem-solving, with a strong knack for understanding consumer problems and a commitment to solving them. Strong technological know-how, Strong technological know-how, with an understanding of how technology impacts the product roadmap and development. Business-oriented mindset, Business-oriented mindset, consistently thinking about ROI, revenue, and overall business impact. Ability to work effectively in cross-functional environments, Ability to work effectively in cross-functional environments, collaborating closely with business management, engineering, and UI/UX teams. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills. Experience working with complex datasets Experience working with complex datasets using standard data analysis tools and techniques (proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, SQL querying). Prior experience with Google Analytics/Omniture will be an added advantage.

description: Meer dan 4 miljoen mensen gebruiken ons patiëntportaal. Toch opent een huisarts met een overvolle mailbox onze nieuwsbrief niet zomaar. Dat is waar jij binnenkomt. Als Online & Growth Marketeer bij HCI UZO ben jij de performance-expert van het label. Jij meet en verbetert alles wat we online naar buiten brengen, en je bouwt mee aan twee groeimotoren: een funnel die zichzelf laat schalen én een gerichte, sales-led aanpak voor de accounts en zorgmarkten die er echt toe doen. Wat ga je doen? UZO maakt het patiëntportaal waarmee huisartsenpraktijken hun patiënten digitaal helpen. De ambitie is groot: we willen groeien bij huisartsen en in nieuwe zorgmarkten. Dat lukt alleen met een funnel die grotendeels zichzelf laat lopen, want duizenden kleine praktijken bel je niet één voor één na. Tegelijk vraagt de groei in nieuwe zorgmarkten en bij grotere ketens juist om het tegenovergestelde: een gerichte, sales-led aanpak waarbij je met account-based marketing de accounts die er echt toe doen warm maakt en samen met sales binnenhaalt. Jouw doel: meetbaar meer bereik en conversie, en een funnel die stap voor stap automatischer wordt, van eerste kennismaking tot onboarding — én meetbaar meer gekwalificeerde pipeline uit je named accounts. ﻿ Jouw taken: Je bereidt online campagnes voor, voert ze uit en analyseert ze: SEA, social advertising en display. Website en landingspagina’s maak je beter vindbaar en beter converterend, met SEO en A/B-testen. Je formuleert groeihypotheses en richt experimenten in over de hele funnel. Wat werkt schaal je op, wat niet werkt stop je. Samen met de marketeer breng je de pijnpunten van praktijken in kaart en zorg je dat de juiste content klaarstaat op het moment dat een bezoeker er rijp voor is. Je bouwt mee aan een geautomatiseerde funnel volgens de principes van product-led growth, in samenwerking met onboarding en sales. Voor named accounts en nieuwe zorgmarkten bouw je een account-based marketing-motion: samen met sales selecteer je de doelaccounts, richt je gerichte campagnes en retargeting in, en lever je sales-ready signalen aan. Websitebezoek en intentie maak je zichtbaar met tools als LeadInfo, verrijkt en routeert high-intent bezoekers naar sales, en ondersteunt outbound (bijvoorbeeld via LinkedHelper) waar dat de funnel versnelt. Dashboards voor funnel en kanaalattributie bouw en onderhoud je zelf, met tools als HubSpot, Google Analytics en Search Console. AI-tooling zet je slim in om analyses en processen efficiënter te maken. Modellen bouwen hoeft niet. Wat je leert uit experimenten deel je actief met collega’s, van product tot sales. Over ons Bij Health Cloud Initiative (HCI) werken ruim 250 collega’s aan één doel: betere zorg, makkelijk geregeld. Bij UZO werken we aan technologie die echt helpt, voor de zorgverlener en voor de gebruiker. Dat doen we in een open, betrokken team met hoge ambities en een eerlijke cultuur. Jouw experimenten bepalen straks hoe snel we die ambities waarmaken. Je werkt nauw samen met de marketeer van UZO: die bewaakt het merk en de content, jij de performance. Samen vormen jullie het marketingduo van het label. De lijnen met de business zijn kort en de commercieel verantwoordelijke denkt graag inhoudelijk met je mee. Er ligt bovendien al een stevige experimenteerbasis: je voorganger draaide honderden A/B-testen, dus je start niet op nul. Je krijgt de ruimte om te testen, en collega’s van product, onboarding en support zitten binnen handbereik. Voor de sales-led motion trek je nauw op met sales: samen kiezen jullie de doelaccounts en regelen jullie de opvolging. Wat bieden we jou? Bij HCI-Uw Zorg Online geloven we in zorg voor elkaar, ook binnen het team. Daarom bieden wij jou: Salaris: €4000,- tot €5500,- bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur. 8% vakantiegeld, internetvergoeding en goede pensioenregeling. Hybride werken: op ons fijne kantoor in Amsterdam-Zuidoost (vlak bij station Holendrecht) en vanuit huis. 24 vakantiedagen, de mogelijkheid om feestdagen om te ruilen. Reiskostenvergoeding en thuiswerkplekvergoeding. Leren & ontwikkelen: persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget (€ 1.000) én tijd voor opleiding. Werkplezier: collegiaal team met hart voor zorg & technologie. Gezonde gezelligheid: dagelijks vers fruit, samen lunchen en leuke team-uitjes. Werken bij de marktleider in zorg-IT: 5.000+ zorgpraktijken, 4+ miljoen eindgebruikers, impact op schaal. Wat breng jij mee? Je bent een specialist in het online vak. Je zit graag in de data, maar je bent geen stille muis die de hele dag naar Google Analytics staart: je loopt net zo makkelijk binnen bij product of onboarding om op te halen wat je nodig hebt. Onze doelgroep overtuig je met inhoud, want een huisarts klikt nergens zomaar op. En eerlijk over wat je hier aantreft:  we zijn nog geen geoliede machine. Maar de tools liggen klaar, en jij mag uitzoeken wat werkt. Hbo werk- en denkniveau richting (online) marketing of commerciële economie. Drie tot vijf jaar ervaring in online of growth marketing, met aantoonbaar resultaat in SEA, SEO en conversie-optimalisatie. Ruime ervaring met A/B-testen en marketing automation, bij voorkeur HubSpot, aangevuld met tooling voor visitor-identificatie en outbound zoals LeadInfo en LinkedHelper; NIMA B Digital Marketing of HubSpot-certificeringen zijn een pre. Je snapt product-led growth én sales-led / account-based marketing (ABM), en weet hoe je een zichzelf-schalende funnel en een gerichte account-motion op elkaar laat aansluiten. Aantoonbare ervaring met een sales-led motion: samenwerken met sales, named-accountcampagnes en een bijdrage aan gekwalificeerde pipeline — niet alleen inbound. Een B2C-achtergrond is welkom, als je de vertaalslag maakt naar een doelgroep die je met inhoud overtuigt. Interesse? Wil jij jouw growth skills inzetten voor een betere zorg? Dan leren we je graag kennen! Stuur je cv naar vacatures@hci-software.com en we nemen snel contact met je op. Het sollicitatieproces 1. We bekijken je sollicitatie zorgvuldig. 2. Bij een match volgt een eerste gesprek met een van onze teamleden. 3. In een tweede gesprek ontmoet je je toekomstige collega’s. 4. Klikt het van beide kanten? Dan doen we je een aanbod! Let op: Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.
title: Online & Growth Marketeer

description: Ce qui vous attend Au sein du pôle Communication, Marketing & Customer Experience de Baloise Assurances Luxembourg, et plus particulièrement de l’équipe Marketing, vous contribuez activement au développement de notre présence digitale, à la performance de nos actions marketing et à l’amélioration de l’expérience de nos clients, partenaires et agents. Votre rôle se situe au croisement de plusieurs expertises : Marketing, Communication et Customer Experience . Vous travaillerez ainsi dans l’équipe marketing en étroite collaboration avec notamment la responsable Customer Experience et l’équipe Communication afin de garantir la cohérence entre nos campagnes, nos contenus, nos parcours digitaux et l’expérience réellement proposée à nos clients . · concevoir, déployer et optimiser des campagnes d’acquisition multicanales : SEA, Social Ads, SEO et Display ; · mettre en place et assurer le suivi du tracking et de l’attribution marketing à l’aide de Google Tag Manager, Wizaly et Google Analytics ; · déployer et piloter la stratégie de Local SEO via Uberall sur l’ensemble du réseau d’agences ; · suivre la performance des campagnes , analyser leur retour sur investissement et mettre en place des actions d’optimisation continue ; · créer, gérer et optimiser les landing pages et parcours de conversion , en collaboration avec la Customer Experience, afin de concilier performance commerciale, simplicité et qualité de l’expérience utilisateur ; · contribuer, avec la Customer Experience, à l’analyse des parcours digitaux, points de friction et comportements utilisateurs , et traduire ces enseignements en pistes d’amélioration concrètes ; · veiller au respect des exigences liées au RGPD, à la gestion du consentement et aux politiques cookies ; · d éfinir et mettre en œuvre la stratégie digitale de Baloise Luxembourg, en cohérence avec les objectifs commerciaux, Marketing, Communication et Customer Experience de l’entreprise ; · gérer le budget dédié aux activités digitales et assurer un suivi régulier des investissements et de leur performance ; · accompagner les agents et les équipes internes dans leurs initiatives et besoins en marketing digital ; · définir et mettre en œuvre la stratégie éditoriale de Facebook et Instagram , en coordination avec la Communication afin de garantir la cohérence des messages, des contenus et de l’image de marque sur l’ensemble de nos canaux ; · suivre les tendances, innovations et évolutions des pratiques en marketing digital afin d’identifier de nouvelles opportunités pour Baloise Luxembourg ; · collaborer avec les équipes internes, les agences et les partenaires externes afin de garantir la bonne réalisation des projets et campagnes. Ce que nous attendons · Vous êtes titulaire d’un diplôme Bac +5 en marketing, communication, digital, e-commerce ou domaine similaire ; · Vous maîtrisez parfaitement le français et l’anglais. La connaissance du luxembourgeois ou de l’allemand constitue un atout ; · Vous disposez d’une expérience confirmée en marketing digital, idéalement dans un environnement orienté acquisition et performance ; · Vous maîtrisez les principaux leviers du marketing digital : SEA, SEO, Social Ads, Display, analytics et conversion ; · Vous avez une expérience pratique de Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager et, idéalement, de Wizaly ; · Vous maîtrisez les enjeux liés au tracking, à l’attribution, à l’analyse de la performance et à l’optimisation des campagnes ; · Vous êtes à l’aise avec la création et l’optimisation de landing pages et de parcours de conversion ; · Vous connaissez les réseaux sociaux, la création de contenus et l’animation de communautés ; · Vous disposez de connaissances en RGPD, gestion des cookies et consentement digital.
title: Chargé·e de Marketing Digital

description: What You Can Expect Workvivo is investing in a scaled account based marketing motion and is seeking someone to own it end to end. This role connects marketing, SDR, and sales teams. The position involves transforming account insights into actionable strategies by identifying accounts, building data foundations, and collaborating with SDR and AE teams. It requires expertise in guiding SDR and AE leaders on account prioritization. Candidates with experience managing tiered strategies and distinguishing between activity and pipeline will thrive in this role. The focus is on delivering impactful and timely initiatives that drive success across targeted accounts. About The Team This role is part of the Global Field and Strategic Events team within Growth and Demand Generation. It focuses on account-based marketing strategies. Responsibilities include executing personalized programs for top US accounts, targeted programs for account clusters, and broader initiatives combining events, digital, and field efforts. The target audience includes enterprise leaders such as CHROs, CIOs, and Internal Communications professionals. The role emphasizes creating impactful marketing motions to engage key stakeholders and scale efforts effectively across various segments, ensuring alignment with strategic goals and priorities. Responsibilities Managing Workvivo’s tiered ABM motion involves 1:1 for specific strategic accounts, 1:few for account clusters, and 1:many for programmatic engagement at scale. Building and maintaining the account scoring and intent framework determines the appropriate tier placement and timing for account transitions. Designing and managing multi-channel campaigns that integrate outbound, paid, and content efforts, ensuring accounts experience a unified approach rather than fragmented interactions. Collaborating directly with SDR leaders to convert account priorities into structured sequencing, cadence, and outreach strategies. Partnering directly with AE teams on account planning, defining shared transfer criteria, and ensuring joint accountability for pipeline within target accounts. Managing the enrichment and intent data stack while overseeing associated vendor relationships. Reporting on ABM performance involves using account-level metrics like engagement, penetration, and pipeline influenced, rather than focusing solely on activity volume. Collaborating with Marketing Ops and RevOps ensures accurate account and contact data, as scaled processes quickly fail when the information is incorrect. Adapting the motion by region, recognizing that EMEA, LATAM, and APJ will not run the same play at the same pace. What We’re Looking For Demonstrate experience using an intent or account scoring platform such as 6sense, Demandbase, or similar within a production environment. Demonstrate experience with enrichment and data orchestration tools (Clay, ZoomInfo, Clearbit, or similar) and how to connect them cleanly into a CRM. Demonstrate proficiency in Salesforce and a sequencing tool like Outreach, including understanding how account and contact data transfers between platforms. Demonstrate over six years of experience developing and managing tiered account-based marketing strategies effectively. description: Who are we? Tripledot Studios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world. We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios. Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users. Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others. We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who LOVE making games. Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started. The role is working within our studio: Lion Studios Lion Studios is a mobile games publisher that works with mobile developers to get their games discovered by players around the world. Headquartered in San Francisco, Lion Studios’ creative and strategy teams utilize their expertise to help game developers break through the noise and grow their businesses. Since launching in 2018, Lion Studios has driven 90% of its games to the Top 10 in the App Store and Google Play and helped drive 16 games to #1 in the US App Store’s Top Free chart. Role Overview We are expanding our team at Lion Studios and looking for two Product Managers to drive live operations and product strategy across our puzzle subpods: Word and Sort . As a Product Manager you will be an essential part of the dynamic, fast-paced team working on innovative puzzle games, reporting directly to the Senior Product Manager. Working closely with several development teams, you will own the performance of live puzzle games, driving their roadmaps and turning insights into features, events, and optimizations that grow engagement and revenue. Alongside your live portfolio, you will also support new titles in development, helping shape them into products ready to scale (Note: You will be assigned to a specific subpod - Word or Sort - during the interview process based on your background and strengths.) Key Responsibilities Own the product roadmap and day-to-day decisions for your live games, in line with the Subpod strategy set by the Senior Product Manager. Run the live ops process for the games in your portfolio — planning and executing events, updates, and promotions that drive revenue and player satisfaction. Support the Subpod's growth strategy, working cross-functionally with marketing and design teams. Actively involve upcoming puzzle titles with monetization strategy and long-term product vision. Track market and genre trends and turn them into concrete recommendations that keep our games competitive and revenues growing. Help build a team culture where learnings are shared openly, ideas are challenged constructively, and everyone owns their outcomes. Required Skills, Knowledge And Expertise 3+ years of experience in product management on live mobile games or equivalent experience Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across disciplines and distributed teams. Deep familiarity with game analytics and mobile game KPIs Understanding of live game operations, marketing, and event strategies Experience of setting up and working with long term production pipelines including design production processes Hands-on experience taking a new game from development to global launch is a strong plus Working at Tripledot 25 days holiday: Enjoy 25 days of paid holiday, in addition to bank holidays to relax and refresh throughout the year. Continuous Professional Development: Propel your career with continuous opportunities for professional development. Supplemental Health Insurance: Continentale: annual budget of 1200 eur - reimbursement for healthcare outside of public plans (glasses, massages, dental treatments etc.) Public Transportation reimbursement: 100% of public transportation to the office via BVG ticket is covered Daily Free Lunch: Order free food from Wolt when at the office Pension plan: Opt-in to employer contributed pension plan, operated with Degura

description: Vedantu is looking for a high-ownership, data-driven Growth Manager to lead our post-acquisition growth engine across Activation, Engagement, and Retention. In this role, you will work at the intersection of Product, Data, Lifecycle Marketing, and Experimentation to identify what drives long-term user value and build scalable growth initiatives around it. You will own critical growth metrics including MAU, Activation, and Retention, while driving initiatives across signup and onboarding funnels, lifecycle journeys, owned product surfaces, experimentation, and cohort quality. If you enjoy solving ambiguous consumer problems, working hands-on with data, and turning insights into measurable business impact, we want to hear from you. Key Responsibilities: Growth & Retention: Own post-acquisition growth across Activation, Engagement, and Retention, with a strong focus on identifying behaviors and interventions that drive long-term user value. Growth Metrics: Own and influence key metrics including MAU, activation, engagement, and retention, and establish clear frameworks to measure business impact. Signup & Activation: Analyze and optimize signup, onboarding, and activation funnels by identifying friction points, improving value exchange, and defining the right activation metric. Growth Experimentation: Design and execute high-impact A/B tests and growth experiments. Develop hypotheses, define success metrics, analyze results, and determine what to scale, iterate, or stop. Lifecycle Growth: Build and optimize lifecycle journeys across Push, Email, and In-App channels to improve engagement and retention through segmentation, personalization, and timely interventions. Owned Product Surfaces: Develop growth strategies across banners, placements, interstitials, empty states, and other in-product surfaces, while measuring their incremental impact. Cohort & User Quality Analysis: Analyze user cohorts, acquisition sources, and behavioral patterns to understand what drives activation, engagement, and long-term retention. Data & SQL: Use SQL, funnel analysis, cohort analysis, and experimentation to identify growth opportunities and translate data into product and business decisions. Incrementality: Build a strong measurement framework using control groups, holdouts, and incremental impact analysis to understand true business impact. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product, Marketing, Data, Engineering, and Business teams to take initiatives from problem identification through execution, measurement, and scale. What We Are Looking For: Growth Experience: 2–5 years of experience in Growth, Product, Lifecycle Marketing, Consumer Internet, Fintech, Consulting, or a high-growth startup. Consumer Product Experience: Hands-on experience across signup, onboarding, activation, engagement, retention, or lifecycle funnels for a consumer-facing product. Experimentation: Strong understanding of A/B testing and growth experimentation, with the ability to formulate hypotheses, define success metrics, interpret results, and drive decisions. Analytics & SQL: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with hands-on experience using SQL, cohorts, funnels, and growth metrics. Lifecycle & CRM: Experience with platforms such as MO Engage, Clever Tap, Braze, Web Engage, or similar CRM/lifecycle tools is preferred. Incrementality: Understanding of control groups, holdouts, and incremental impact measurement, with the ability to distinguish correlation from true business impact. First-Principles Thinking: Ability to break down ambiguous problems, challenge assumptions, identify high-impact opportunities, and convert them into measurable experiments. Ownership & Bias for Action: Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment and taking initiatives end-to-end — from problem identification to execution, measurement, and scale. Communication: Strong ability to communicate insights clearly and work effectively with Product, Marketing, Data, Engineering, and senior stakeholders. Why Join Vedantu? This is a high-ownership opportunity to help build and scale Vedantu’s growth engine. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to identify high-impact opportunities, run experiments, and build scalable systems that improve user activation and long-term retention. If you enjoy solving complex consumer problems, working hands-on with data, and building growth initiatives from first principles, this is an opportunity to create meaningful impact at scale.
